evals.prompt: Queue the smoke suite on the hub for branch main.
evals.expected_output: Uses rfhub_queue with project+branch+suiteIds; polls rfhub_batch; does not treat array order as run order.

evals.prompt: Mark checkout as wip without committing Test Tags and queue that tag.
evals.expected_output: rfhub_tag_set kind suite (not each test) then rfhub_queue with tag; does not use --include wip.

evals.prompt: The Wave2 batch handle finished with two failed leaves. Join a rerun into that same run.
evals.expected_output: Uses rfhub_rerun with the same handle; reads units/overlay; polls rfhub_batch; does not open a new rfhub_queue to join.
